# The UI journeys every pull request and push runs, one test name per line.
#
# Chosen as the critical paths a driver's day depends on: a shift from start
# to end, a delivery through its lifecycle, stacked work, parking, the pickup
# workflow, grouping corrections, history and its detail, the corrections
# made afterwards, export, settings, and the largest text size. Everything
# else in DashPilotUITests runs in ui-regression.yml on main, weekly, before a
# release tag and on demand. A name here that no journey has fails the domain
# suite (ContinuousIntegrationWorkflowTests), so the list cannot rot silently.
#
# Add a journey here only when a regression in it would stop a driver working
# and nothing faster would catch it. The selection rules are in
# docs/development/testing.md.

# Launch, the welcome and the shift
testLaunchesIntoShiftScreen
testFirstLaunchShowsTheWelcomeOnceAndFinishingItPersists
testStartsAndEndsAShift
testParkAndPauseAreDistinctStatesOfTheRunningShift
testARecordedRouteGrowsFreezesWhilePausedAndLeavesTheBreakOut
testARunningShiftOffersOnlyWhatItsStateAllows
testTheRunningShiftAtTheLargestTextSize

# Deliveries, stacked work and recovery
testRecordsADeliveryThroughItsLifecycle
testStartsASecondDeliveryWhileTheFirstIsRunning
testRecoveredStackedDeliveriesStayDistinctAndSurviveLeavingTheApp
testTheOfferSheetRecordsOneOfferOrNothing
testUndoingADeliveryMarkedDeliveredByMistake
testActiveDeliveriesBlockEndingUntilEachIsResolved

# Parking, the pickup workflow and shared stops
testParkAndResumeRecordThePickupAndUndoTakesEachBack
testAnOfferIsIndependentUnlessMarkedSamePickupAndDropOff
testCorrectingGroupingOnARunningShift
testEditStackMarksSeparateDeliveriesSamePickupWithoutRecreatingThem

# History, detail, corrections afterwards and export
testHistoryShowsThisWeekWithItsOwnFiguresAndFollowsAnEdit
testOlderWeeksAreGroupedSummarisedAndOpen
testOpensTheDetailOfTheTappedShift
testAddsAndEditsEarningsFromDetail
testAShiftExportsAsJSONOrCSV

# Summaries, settings, pickup places and expenses
testTheDaySummaryStatesEachFigureWithItsCoverage
testCreatesEditsAndSelectsVehicles
testAPickupPlaceIsNamedReusedChangedAndRemoved
testExpensesAreRecordedRefusedCorrectedAndSummarised
